d:
Israil men chunavi natijon ke mutabik arab netritv vali partiyan is bar kingmekar ban sakti hain. is chunav men arab israiliyon ne barh-charhkar hissa liya aur bari sankhya men vot dalne pahunche.
Israili arab israil ki aabadi ka panchvan hissa hain. israil men rah rahe arab logon men zyadatar aabadi muslimon ki hai. yun to israil yahudiyon ka desh hai, to yahan musalmanon ki itni aabadi kaise hai? kaun hain israil men rahne vale arab? israil men kaisa hai arab logon ka hal? aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
Riport: bibisi nyuz
Aavaz: priyanka
